_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Compact, independently checked native-precision telemetry reduces sample traffic by 49.1%. Every connection retains exact RX/TX bytes, complete named signal CSVs, all configuration/command/reply/error records, units, clock origins and delivery summaries. Main measurement CSVs distinguish measured pressure, actuator feedback, tracking error and firmware PID error. No pressure-control, calibration, PVR algorithm or sample-rate changes.

Bench: calibrated device C, GE Large Adult Long cuff/mandrel, ProSim8. Final ten-minute seed 213 soak after the final protected flash: 30,606/30,606 samples received (100.00%); 5 completed cycles. Earlier soak: 30,560/30,560 (100.00%). High Max with OLED mirroring: 7,649/7,649, detected crest 141.77 mmHg, PVR 140 mmHg, analysis 8.825 s. STOP during analysis reached the pump-off, vented threshold in 3.344 s. All journal mirrors match, with zero decode/write errors. Native NI retains 713,700 samples per channel on three channels at 500 Hz, without acquisition gaps/backtracks. 230 focused tests and seven standard GUI checks passed. Existing large-cuff tracking limitations remain; these tests do not establish an absolute future-loss guarantee.

Application v3.1.376; firmware rev27v-followup-351 (11/11/2026). Source default b2c68c79441a66cf937cc56b78974f8da9156c81. MATLAB function and three-page algorithm guide remain included; the PVR detector is unchanged. Unsigned installer publication uses the operator-authorized AllowUnsigned policy.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
